high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "madovermarketing_mom." The post features a photograph of a man standing next to a digital decibel meter mounted on a signal pole. The decibel meter displays "000 dB" in red LED lights. Below the photo, there is a caption that reads: "In true Mumbai Police fashion, it decided to deter habitual honkers by installing decibel meters to a few signal poles around the city where traffic is heavy. If the decibel level went over 85 dB, the signal timer would reset, resulting in double the waiting time for impatient honkers."
